crossRefs.note: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.
When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on…
My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the…
Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.
They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

translations.web: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.
translations.bsb: When the dew fell on the camp at night, the manna would fall with it.
